:{{pov|[[Rand]]}}

He arrives at [[Emond's Field]] to find that it has also been attacked by [[Trollocs]]{{ref|foo}}.  He is met by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], who inspects [[Tam al'Thor|Tam]] and concludes that she can do nothing for him{{ref|bar}}.  Rand goes to the [[Winespring Inn]] to find [[Thom Merrillin|Thom]] and [[Brandelwyn al'Vere|Bran al'Vere]], the latter of whom installs Tam in one of the rooms of the inn.  Thom steers the conversation to [[Moiraine Damodred|Moiraine]], who revealed herself as [[Aes Sedai]] in the fight against the Trollocs.  Rand goes to Moiraine and swears to pay any price{{ref|baz}} if she [[Healing|Heal]]s Tam.
